findings.summary: Failed bookkeeping commit leaves .bee staged in the user's index, unreported — a later user commit (e.g. merge resolution) silently carries bee's changes
findings.evidence: repro: merge-in-progress -> add ok, partial commit refused exit 128, index left staged

findings.summary: git_failed reason and warning line can be empty when the failing hook prints nothing
findings.evidence: pre-commit hook exit 1 with silent streams -> reason 'git_failed:' and warning line with trailing colon

findings.summary: Non-boolean close_commit_bookkeeping silently reads as config_off — R81 and the cited precedent demand a loud refusal; a test pins the wrong behavior
findings.evidence: string 'true' -> silent config_off, .bee stays dirty with no signal

findings.summary: No test covers the git_failed branch, the warning-line render, or reason clean — the whole user-visible failure surface is unpinned
commit runs without --no-gpg-sign or timeout; gpgsign+pinentry repo can hang close (fixture defends itself, prod path does not)
R81 says GREEN close; an undeclared-tests close also auto-commits — spec under-describes
Linked-worktree .git-file branch proven by hand, not by the suite
not_a_repo test is TMPDIR-dependent; under a git-owned TMPDIR it would stage into a real repo — set GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES
change_class behavior but trace.behavior_change false — scribing-debt door never armed (capture landed anyway, mechanism bypassed not satisfied)
